title: PeerReviewAgents
description:
PeerReviewAgents produces an evidence-linked peer review of a manuscript PDF. One command imports the PDF locally into immutable source blocks with evidence handles, runs independent reviewers against bounded manuscript and literature tools, and synthesizes their findings through an audited debate in which every original finding must be retained, merged, rejected with reasons, or sent for verification. Every finding carries the source block it is anchored to and the exact quotation it rests on; a quotation that does not match the manuscript is quarantined rather than reported. Reviews run on a signed-in Claude Code or Codex subscription and make no API-key calls. Each run records its manuscript manifest, tool logs, coverage record, and model usage, and the reports are written from that saved JSON without further inference, so a stopped or blocked run still reports what it produced. The command line, a local web UI, an MCP server, and plugins for local coding agents all run the same review. The system is research software for review assistance and evaluation, not a substitute for accountable editorial judgment.

Garrett, Garcia-Carbonell and Navarro Garrido contributed equally.
